_comment: Project-wide Linear context for the rmp harness. The TOP-LEVEL keys are the default that rmp 0.4.0 skills read — they know nothing about `products`. This monorepo ships more than one product, so per-product Linear projects are listed below for humans and agents. A feature belonging to a non-default product MUST carry its own `linear_project_id` in its spec frontmatter (docs/specs/<slug>.md), and that value wins over the default. Top-level stays on Crema Arena so existing specs keep resolving.
